name: nepra-pp-mcp
description: Pakistan's electricity regulator publishes the country's only plant-level power data as Excel-exported HTML that reads as empty and PDFs nobody extracts — this turns it into a queryable panel and names every gap.

nepra_base_url.title: NEPRA_BASE_URL
nepra_base_url.description: Optional. Sets NEPRA_BASE_URL for the NEPRA MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

nepra_user_agent.title: NEPRA_USER_AGENT
nepra_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets NEPRA_USER_AGENT for the NEPRA MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
